_default.title: Validate the problem
_default.detail: Interview 5 target customers this week and ask how they currently solve the problem.

_default.title: Size the market
_default.detail: Estimate the TAM, SAM, and SOM using bottom-up numbers from public sources.

_default.title: Define your wedge
_default.detail: Pick one persona, one use case, one geography. Resist spreading too thin.

education.title: Education wedge
education.detail: Start with after-school tutoring for grade 5–8 students in underserved districts.

education.title: Validate via schools
education.detail: Pilot with 2 schools for a 4-week trial before building product.

marketplace.title: Two-sided risk
marketplace.detail: Solve the chicken-and-egg problem by subsidising the supply side for the first 90 days.

marketplace.title: Trust signals
marketplace.detail: Build verifiable reviews and an escrow mechanism before scaling.

health.title: Compliance first
health.detail: Engage a regulatory consultant before designing the core flow.

health.title: Clinical evidence
health.detail: Plan a small pilot study to collect outcome data you can share with payers.

fintech.title: Regulatory landscape
fintech.detail: Map the licenses required (KYC/AML) and budget 3–6 months for the first one.
